results.name: 30MM Marlin
results.description:
The 30MM MARLIN is an advanced, small caliber, weapon system.

This 3D model was created using 3ds Max, with textures designed in Substance Painter. The model has been meticulously unwrapped and divided into separate parts, enabling the base and turret to rotate seamlessly. results.name: RUCUS-UGV
results.description:
Rugged Umanned Combat Universal System 

The RUCUS is a family of multipurpose unmanned ground vehicles. The RUCUS weights around 2 tons and can carry up to 2500 kg of payload. It has two remote station mounts that allow it carry a variety of modular weapons; this includes up to 12 different variants. It has self contained power, auto-vision, waypoint navigations, and autonmous navigation. Two can be carried by a heavy-lift helicopter.

Here is the IFV-SCOUT variant which has a M230 30mm RWS and a Extended mast sensor. This allows the RUCUS to scout in complex terrian, other variants include patrol, anti-air, anti-tank, anti-drone, supply, ammo transport, and direct fire support including 30mm cannon. 

Learn more at https://killcapturedestroy.com/

results.name: Upiór Infantry Fighting Vehicle
results.description:
The Upiór Infantry Fighting Vehicle (IFV) represents a unique hybrid of Western and Eastern armored vehicle technologies. The Ukrainian army initiated a project where they combined elements from the U.S. Bradley Fighting Vehicle with turrets inspired by the BMP-2, resulting in the creation of the Upiór. This vehicle saw substantial deployment by the Ukrainian army during the later stages of the conflict.

The Upiór shares the armored protection capabilities of the Bradley, reinforced with locally manufactured Explosive Reactive Armor (ERA) blocks, further enhancing its survivability on the battlefield. At its core, the Upiór is armed with a potent domestically produced 30mm cannon, which serves as its primary weapon system. The Upior replaces the Bradelys TOW missile with a locally produced ATGM but uses the Bradelys day/night optics, fire control, defensives systems, and radios and internals.

Learn more at https://killcapturedestroy.com/

results.name: BMMP-1 AMPHIBIOUS INFANTRY FIGHTING VEHICLE
results.description:
The BMMP-1 is a amphibious infantry fighting vehicle design to replace the soviet era PT-76. The BMMP-1 comes in two primary configurations, the anti-tank variant is equipped with BEREZHOK turret which has 4x KORNET ATGM launchers and a 30MM cannon and coaxial heavy machine gun.
the other configuration is designed to defeat bunkers and infantry has a AU-122M unmanned turret which mounts a 57mm cannon, 2x KORNET ATGM launchers and a light coaxial machine gun. 

Both vehicles are design for water operations using a hydroplane and water jet system, they can move at up to 40km a hour in sea states up to  3. The BMMP-1 is design to be launch from assault ships in the Russian navy and transport Russian naval infantry from water to land.

read more at https://killcapturedestroy.com/

results.name: Low Poly Lazar 3 Multipurpose Fighting Vehicle
results.description: I came back from a rather long break and decided to try something new. This thing here is classified as a multipurpose fighting vehicle though it falls in the APC category by western standards. Its armor level is Lvl 3 and Lvl 3+ up front (STANAG 4569) by default but it can be upped to Lvl 4 and Lvl 5 up front. It has a max speed of 110 km/h. There are many configurations of this vehicle but the one i modeled is equipped with a 30mm cannon some of you might find familiar since it's the same one used on the BTR-80A (2A72) but of course modified and modernised. I picked this version because it looks the most badass. The model isn't a 1:1 replica since I've given myself some artistic freedom but it's okay I guess.

results.name: Unmanned Surface Vessel JARI
results.description:
JARI USV or Hùshì shā 护士鲨 or NATO Nurse Shark Class is a PLAN advanced unmanned surface vessel which can operate in tandem with larger manned surface ships or autonmously in swarms of other unmanned surface ships, the JARI is designed to be rearmed from a mothership and can operate up to 1500km away from the mothership using combination of line of sight, satillite navigation, and AI system to operate the ships various functions. The JARI is equipped with 2 ET25 lightweight torpedos for ASW and two VLS cells for antishipping and anti-aircraft roles. The JARI has a remote weapons station with a 30mm cannon and two fire and forget anti-tank missiles. The JARI primary role is to act as a forward sensor node and shooter for the chinese navy larger surface ships. The JARI can detect submarines and surface vessels from far away and then attack targets with the same weapons system onboard the motherships, a single destory can carry up to 4 JARI which are only 15m long.

Learn more at https://killcapturedestroy.com/

results.name: Mulso Unmanned Ground Combat Support System
results.description:
The Mulso was developed by a consortium of South Korean defense companies, originally design as an autonomous space rover the Mulso was converted into a unmanned combat system by the South Korean Military who saw its use as a squad level support robot. The Mulso weights less then 2 tons, can operate for up to 72 hours on a single charge, and can be transported by helicopter.

The MULSO is designed with high mobility in mind, it has four multi-jointed articulated legs which can function as both wheels and legs allowing the MULSO to overcome complex terrain and maneuver in tight urban settings, MULSO can climb stairs or scale the sides of buildings by adjusting its leg positions. This allows it to shift its center of mass and height allowing it to peak and hide. 

.The MULSO is armed with an RWS-2 Remote Weapon Station which can mount a light or heavy machine gun, or 30mm cannon; Up to 10 MML Missile Pods

Learn more at https://killcapturedestroy.com/

results.name: CVR-T Scimitar Armoured Reconnaissance Vehicle
results.description: The FV107 Scimitar is an armoured reconnaissance vehicle (sometimes classed as a light tank) used by the British Army. It was manufactured by Alvis in Coventry. It is very similar to the FV101 Scorpion, but mounts a high velocity 30 mm L21 RARDEN cannon instead of a 76 mm gun. It was issued to Royal Armoured Corps armoured regiments in the reconnaissance role. Each regiment originally had a close reconnaissance squadron of five troops, each containing eight FV107 Scimitars.

results.name: Y-12DC Furious Panda
results.description:
The Y-12DC or NATO J-130 Furious Panda is the PLAAF close air support gunship. The Furious Panda is based on the Y-12 Panda light cargo transport. The J-130 is optmized for day/night air to ground attack, it mounts a powerful multi-mode AESA/SAR radar that can detect targets up to 150km away. 8x external hardpoints for laser/radar guided missiles, glide bombs or anti-ship missiles. There is a centerline dual feed 30mm cannon with over 1500 rounds. The J-130 has numerous countermeasure systems to avoid surface to air missiles, include a direct infrared laser which can disable the IR sensor of a incoming missile, it has a Missile warning system that can detect and automatic release flares or chaff based on the incoming missile. A powerful jamming pod blanks the area with radio noise and thick plate armor has been added to the botom of the aircraft to protect against ground fire. 

The PLAAF uses the J-130 to support Chinese special operations Airborne Commando units.
